sv.title: Norwegian hackat – ber kunder spärra betalkort
sv.summary: Omkring 5 000 kunder hos flygbolaget Norwegian, däribland i Sverige, har ombetts att spärra sina bankkort efter ett dataintrång hos en av bolagets leverantörer.

en.title: Norwegian hacked – asks customers to block payment cards
en.summary: About 5,000 customers of airline Norwegian, including in Sweden, have been asked to block their bank cards after a data breach at one of the company's suppliers.
